skill.summary: Create concise 60-90 second videos showcasing property managers' investor services, tenant screening, maintenance, and communication for marketing and client...

latestVersion.changelog:
Initial release of Property Manager Video

- Enables property management companies to create short videos showcasing their investor services, tenant screening process, and maintenance coordination.
- Guides users to specify the type of video (overview, investor service, tenant screening, maintenance, or reporting).
- Collects relevant details about property portfolio, management approach, and communication practices.
- Generates 60–90 second video scripts tailored to demonstrate service quality and management capability to real estate investors.
- Supports a variety of video ideas: property manager explanations, investor testimonials, maintenance demonstrations, and owner reporting walkthroughs.
